timeline.tweet: Mental health is hard. Even harder for others to understand if they've never struggled with it.Moving, working, parenting, attempting a new relationship, all can cause anxiety and does not get better overnight.What I've done/do is take baby steps.

This exact time last year I was diagnosed with depression and anxiety disorder. I took off 6mnths from work to manage my mental health. I decided to pause on blogging just because it was overwhelming at the time. I returned April 2018 andhave not suffered with depression since.
